expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.lead: Structural design, calculations and BIM support — from concept to delivery, focused on clarity, speed and coordination.

precast.title: Precast concrete structures
precast.body: Design of precast elements (walls, slabs, beams, columns) with BIM coordination and detailing of reinforcement, connections and erection. Focus: producibility, tolerances and fast assembly.

concrete.title: Reinforced concrete structures
concrete.body: RC structural design with clear calculations, rational detailing and reliable documentation. Section and reinforcement optimization with coordination across disciplines.

steel.title: Steel structures
steel.body: Steel framing and connection detailing, solution variants and interdisciplinary coordination. Focus: precise details, constructability and efficient fabrication.

management.title: Project management
management.body: Delivery planning, task tracking and clear communication workflows. Focus: deadlines, transparency and quality control throughout the project.

software.title: Custom software solutions
software.body: Automation and tooling for engineering workflows: AutoLISP for AutoCAD productivity, C#/.NET plugins and utilities, and JavaScript (Node.js + web) for dashboards, calculators and file-processing pipelines.

about.title: About us
about.p1: PRECON Design is an engineering office based in Niš (Serbia), focused on structural design, reinforcement detailing and BIM support for international partners.
about.p2: Geographically, we are well positioned to collaborate with European teams — fast communication, clear standards and clean documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
about.p3: Niš is a university city with a strong engineering base and a steady inflow of young talent, enabling stable team growth and reliable delivery even on tight schedules.

servicesPage.title: Services
servicesPage.lead: We provide structural engineering, detailing and BIM support for precast concrete, concrete and steel structures — with a focus on clarity, coordination and production-ready documentation.

precast.title: Precast concrete structures
precast.lead: Support throughout the full development process of a precast system — from concept and coordination to modeling, detailing and production-ready documentation.
precast.p1: We work on the design and development of walls, slabs, beams, columns and other prefabricated elements, with particular attention to manufacturability, tolerances, transport and erection logic.
precast.p2: The goal is not only to deliver a structural solution, but to prepare clear, coordinated and practical documentation that fits real production and project workflows.

concrete.title: Concrete structures
concrete.lead: Development of reinforced concrete systems with a focus on structural logic, reinforcement detailing, multidisciplinary coordination and dependable technical documentation.
concrete.p1: Our work includes structural analysis, technical development, reinforcement planning and coordination with architecture and MEP disciplines throughout different project stages.
concrete.p2: We aim to produce documentation that is technically consistent, easy to follow and aligned with practical execution requirements on site.

steel.title: Steel structures
steel.lead: Development of steel systems from structural concept and coordination to connection detailing, fabrication documentation and support during execution.
steel.p1: We work on steel frames, secondary members, connection logic and technical documentation with a strong focus on precision, constructability and fabrication efficiency.
steel.p2: The result is a coordinated and practical package that supports both design development and downstream production processes.

aboutPage.heroLead: Precon Design is an engineering partner focused on precast concrete, reinforced concrete and steel structures, with a practical BIM-oriented approach to coordination and production-ready documentation.
aboutPage.processLead: Our workflow is built around clear technical communication, strong coordination and documentation that is useful both for the design team and for production.

item1.title: Concept and coordination
item1.body: At an early stage, we analyze the system, geometry and project constraints in order to establish a clear and efficient development path.

item2.title: Modeling and development
item2.body: We develop the structure through BIM and technical detailing, with a focus on consistency across elements, details and delivery phases.

item3.title: Documentation for execution
item3.body: We prepare drawings and technical documentation that are clear, practical and aligned with real production and construction needs.

aboutPage.softwareLead: We rely on proven tools for modeling, coordination, technical development and internal process automation.
